title: 33lb Food Scale, Digital Kitchen Scale Batteries and USB Charging,1g/0.05oz Precise Graduation, Waterproof Stainless Steel with LCD Display Weight Grams and oz for Cooking Baking (Stainless Steel)
description:
About this item
【Two Power Source】：USB charging or 2 AAA batteries power supply, you can use it more reliably.
【Precise Weight】: Accurate, elegant, easy-to-use digital kitchen food scale for your largest and smallest cooking projects . Measuring range: 0.1oz to 33 lbs (3g to 15kg).
【Multifunction Scale】： Automatic Unit Button instantly converts between 5 units of measurements (kg g lb:oz fl.oz ml) and displays results on an easy-to-read Lcd screen.
【Practical Design】 The food scale is designed with tempered glass for strong bearing, sleek stainless steel top surface for anti-fingerprint and easy clean, with a attached hook for convenient storage.
【Zero/Tare Function】: Convenient tare button for tare calculation allows you to subtract the weight of plate or container, making it easy to achieve accurate readouts of ingredients.
reviews_5s: This is the 3rd scale I have purchased in the past few years and this one is by far the best. Extremely easy to use. Weight is accurate. You can use metric and pounds and ounces. You can easily change between the two with touch of a the unit button. Cleaning is easy with a damp cloth. The design is very pleasing to the eye it is the easiest scale I have ever owned. Push the button to turn it on, put your bowl/plate or whatever on the top and zero it out and add your item. You can choose the unit weight at this time. You can toggle between metric and US weights at any time. The size is perfect to just sit on your counter without taking up space. Everything about this little gem is perfect for our family. I highly recommend it.Man I am happy I bought this! Easy, well lit display. LOVE the tare feature. Charge lasts quite long for me. Easy wipe off top and it's stylish. Doesn't take up much space either so win all around!! I really like it so far for the time I have had it.On my sourdough journey, I realized I needed a more accurate kitchen scale. This one seems much more accurate and is much easier to use than my other. I love the size and flat shape of this digital scale. Great visibility of the weight readings on the lit screen. Any liquids (or solids) spilled on this scale are easily wiped up and I can store it on its side like a thin cookbook. It isn't stored for long, though as I am baking more often and my sourdough bread is turning out better!I got this scale for my wife as she is always buying and measuring out various foods and recipes. The display works well and the brightness is ample for low light environments. It is easy to use and it's slim construction makes storage when not in use a breeze.The product has a large enough surface for large bowls, cleans very easy, It’s recommended to use a scale for a more accurate measurement when baking, I’m solded, no more measuring cups for me.Great looking just what I orderedAwesome works excellent would buy again!! Highly recommend. I like nice things and this is very nice looking and durable and I’m kinda a high end person and this scale is good looking, durable, and does the job very well more than I expected!!Perfect size to weigh my foods on, plates and whatever else I need to weigh. Easy to charge and very easy to use!Good productI bought this scale to use in my candle business. The 1st scale came used. 🤨 It had something on the top of the stainless. It didn't come with a blue peel off film. I purchased a second scale and it did have the peel off film. I'm sending the first scale ordered back. The 2nd scale all works well. 👍 I like that it comes with batteries and a charging cord to charge with power also. The charger on the scale has the small adapter insert on the right side to plug in for charging. It will be charged completely after it shows on the screen 3 full bars. 👍 It's very easy to use and read. It has a bright light on the screen. It appears to be made well and I'm pleased with the NEW scales. Just make sure it has a blue peel off film or it's been used. 👍 ⚖️
reviews_1s: No matter what I did it jumped 3/10's of an oz - whether I added or subtracted a little bit at a time. i.e. 2.99 oz to 3.02 (never would do exact measurements). Also, took 2 to 3 Zero presses to actually zero out. Some say it's sensitive, yet, when you get the same numbers over and over again (jump back and for 3/10th) no matter what, that's not sensitive, that's wildly inaccurate. Did the same with lb.oz/fl.oz/grams. I just got tired of trying to get an accurate measurement. Had to returnI hate that I even have to give it one star. I read the instructions. It was already fully charged. I had it at zero for pounds and ounces. I put a jar to test it…..and nothing. Put the batteries in thought they might help, put the jar back on and nothing. No matter what I put on it, it reads 000. Sending it back.The bottom of the scale slopes inward, making the base unstable. Any movement at all makes the scale inaccurate. It needs a stable base. This design flaw makes the scale unusable.
